methodology: One hundred scenario records were manually specified in advance, including operational narratives, omissions, adversarial strings, exact known values and oracle labels. A deterministic one-use authoring helper copied eight domain/taxonomy fixtures, seven operational SOP templates plus one unspecified template, fixed synthetic UUID namespaces, fixed timestamps, canonical staff scoring and exact source hashes into each complete JSON snapshot. Shared templates were expanded during authoring only. This committed JSON file is the complete dataset; the evaluation loader validates it and reads exact bytes without case generation, randomization or live retrieval. Hand-specified analysis isolates recommendation behavior. All live cases use TRIAGED because that is the sole state accepted by scheduling; rejected-state/currentness checks belong to the independent failure matrix. Pre-final oracle-only review added seven distinct forbidden literal probes to every case, including known-field substitutions, and exact UTC clock aliases for supplied ISO incident times. This correction does not alter any request/evidence/model input. The initial authoring assumption START_WORK-only when missingFields is empty was corrected after reviewing the owning Recommendation V2 prompt, which explicitly permits both START_WORK and REQUEST_USER_INFO at TRIAGED. This aligns the oracle with the existing product contract; deliberately missing required facts still require REQUEST_USER_INFO and RESOLVE is forbidden for all cases. The preflight preserves the initial dataset bytes and measured action variability. No product or model input changed. Independent review of the interrupted v2.5 run found that cases019 and029 omitted affectedCount in analysis but accidentally repeated the original population in impact prose. Only those two impact sentences and their protected known-value labels were corrected to state that population is unconfirmed; request/context copies remain identical to one another and all other known facts, case order, IDs, timestamps and sources remain frozen. All21 deliberately missing cases were checked for incidental current facts. Cases002 and009 received an explicit evaluation-only unverifiedCause oracle after retained affirmative unsupported-cause outputs; their request/evidence inputs did not change.
limitations: Supplied context fixtures do not establish live ingestion, embedding, retrieval recall, PostgreSQL ranking or production recommendation accuracy. Separate existing-architecture probes may measure those interactions.
Fixture embeddingIdentity is explicitly synthetic; dimension 1024 here is a schema-valid fixture property, not proof of the installed embedding model dimension.
Seven operational taxonomy scenarios use eight hand-authored SOP templates; no SOP contains real customer data. Scores/workload are synthetic context values, not staff quality measurements.

Known/forbidden-fact oracles and exact reference membership provide deterministic checks. Automated prose interpretation cannot prove absence of every possible invented statement; accepted output and limitations remain available for review.

All 100 model contexts are TRIAGED; invalid workflow states and post-generation changes are independently tested against backend behavior. SLA state values are supplied canonical snapshots, not recomputed during authoring or by the model.
Required missing device/system and reproduction information map to the existing description missing field; no taxonomy or public missing-field vocabulary is added.

Case M15-099 has a three-character description and tests direct RecommendationEvidenceV2/model-context robustness. The request-creation API would reject that description under its minimum length; it is not evidence that an end-to-end user-created request accepts malformed text.
